propositions: Retire the module-size allowlist escape hatch and enforce an absolute 800-LOC cap on all src/rebar/**/*.py files.

Implement a limit-lock mechanism that fetches main's tip by explicit GitHub URL and fails with 'must override' if the limit file differs from the base, unless the file is absent on main (bootstrap case).

Rewrite the Module-size gate step in both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml to read the limit from a single source file (.github/module-size-limit.txt), apply the absolute cap with no exemptions, and emit a warning on fetch failure rather than silently falling back.

Update test_module_size_contract.py to validate that no src/rebar file exceeds the limit read from the limit file, and update test_ci_workflow_parity.py to recognize the new limit file as a shared gate artifact.
Keep the now-empty allowlist and ceilings files on this change to prevent main's current gate from breaking on its own CI, pending Phase 2b deletion.
